name: vuena-assets

license.note: All listed models are CC0 1.0 (public domain). Use freely, including commercially, no credit needed.

ai_disclosure: The models are generated procedurally by code written with AI assistance. No AI image or 3D generators were used for the meshes.

bundle.name: Vuena All-in-1
bundle.contents: Every Vuena 3D asset pack plus future packs, in one purchase.

packs.name: Store & Supermarket Simulator Kit
packs.contents: 317 realistic PBR assets for supermarket and shop games (shelving, products, checkout and more).

packs.name: Gas Station + Roadside Cafe Simulator Kit
packs.contents: 290 PBR assets for a gas station and roadside cafe game.

packs.name: Modular Apartment Interior Kit
packs.contents: 200 PBR assets for modular apartment interiors.

packs.name: Factory & Production Line Simulator Kit
packs.contents: 167 PBR assets for factory and production-line games.

packs.name: Rigged Blocky Characters
packs.contents: 61 low-poly rigged characters on a shared skeleton, plus 30 animations.

packs.name: Low-Poly Toy Cars
packs.contents: 50 toy cars with separate wheels and 3 colourways.

packs.name: Cute Pets & Wildlife
packs.contents: 70 rigged low-poly animals sharing 13 animation clips.

packs.name: Blocky Winter & Christmas
packs.contents: 43 winter and Christmas props plus 3 rigged characters with 30 animations.

packs.name: PSX First-Person Arms & Items Kit
packs.contents: Rigged first-person arms with 21 animations and 30 held items.

packs.name: Blocky Monsters (Halloween)
packs.contents: Rigged blocky monsters and Halloween props.
packs.note: Monsters are a bonus in the Blocky Characters pack
